claims.claim: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said the agency is monitoring prediction markets for possible manipulation ahead of the 2026 U.S. midterms, and the accessible account of his October 23 Bloomberg interview identifies no new election-related enforcement case.
claims.episode_span: Chairman Michael Selig said the Commodity Futures Trading Commission is monitoring prediction markets for possible manipulation ahead of the 2026 U.S. midterms
claims.source_title: Prediction markets face CFTC scrutiny ahead of 2026 US midterms
claims.supporting_quote: The summary says the agency is watching for signs of manipulation ahead of the midterms, without identifying a new election-related enforcement case.

claims.claim: Dune's October 20 research put combined Kalshi and Polymarket midterm open interest at $250 million as of October 18, with $210 million on Kalshi and $40 million on Polymarket.
claims.episode_span: combined Kalshi and Polymarket midterm open interest at $250 million as of October 18, with $210 million on Kalshi and $40 million on Polymarket
claims.source_title: Prediction markets face CFTC scrutiny ahead of 2026 US midterms
claims.supporting_quote: Dune attributed $210 million of midterm open interest to Kalshi and $40 million to Polymarket in its dated snapshot.

claims.claim: Dune counted $59 million in combined notional trading in the seven days through October 18, and over the cycle $353 million notional on Kalshi and $160 million on Polymarket, with cash volume of $147 million and $77 million.
claims.episode_span: $59 million in combined notional trading in the seven days through October 18, and over the cycle $353 million notional on Kalshi and $160 million on Polymarket
claims.source_title: Prediction markets face CFTC scrutiny ahead of 2026 US midterms
claims.supporting_quote: Over the election cycle, Dune counted $353 million in notional volume on Kalshi and $160 million on Polymarket.

claims.claim: Dune found 24,930 Polymarket wallets held midterm positions, with a median position of $14, and the top 100 wallets accounted for 56 percent of position value.
claims.episode_span: 24,930 Polymarket wallets in midterm positions, a median position of $14, and 56 percent of position value in the top 100 wallets
claims.source_title: Prediction markets face CFTC scrutiny ahead of 2026 US midterms
claims.supporting_quote: The same analysis found that 24,930 Polymarket wallets held midterm positions, with a median position of $14.

claims.claim: On August 28 the CFTC ordered Gabriel Perez to return $107,539.02 and pay a $65,000 civil penalty with a three-year trading ban for trading on presidential speech wording from December 2025 through February 2026.
claims.episode_span: the CFTC ordered Gabriel Perez to return $107,539.02 and pay a $65,000 civil penalty, with a three-year trading ban
claims.source_title: Prediction markets face CFTC scrutiny ahead of 2026 US midterms
claims.supporting_quote: The agency ordered former White House teleprompter operator Gabriel Perez to return $107,539.02 in trading profits and pay a $65,000 civil penalty.

claims.claim: On July 31 the CFTC ordered George Santos to return $17,569.98 and pay a $17,500 civil penalty with a three-year trading ban over State of the Union attendance contracts.

claims.supporting_quote: Santos was ordered to return $17,569.98 in profits and pay a $17,500 civil penalty.

claims.claim: Husch Blackwell attorneys Jeff Le Riche and Kip Randall wrote on October 2 that a September 22 CFTC advisory neither banned mention contracts nor created new legal obligations.

claims.supporting_quote: Husch Blackwell attorneys Jeff Le Riche and Kip Randall explained that the advisory neither banned mention contracts outright nor created new legal obligations.

claims.claim: A paper training market makers on Polymarket reconstructed order-level data and trained agents on 417 real markets; none of the configurations established positive average portfolio value on periodic held-out evaluation.

claims.source_title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
claims.supporting_quote: None establishes positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration was trained with one seed.
